q: How do I count tipper truck emissions on a construction site?
title: Tipper truck emissions per trip
short: Record diesel issued to each tipper and trips made, multiply litres by 2.68 kg CO2, and divide by trips or tonnes moved. Tippers you operate are Scope 1; a hauling contractor paid per trip is Scope 3. Weighbridge slips give the tonnes.
audience: Contractors and builders tracking site fuel

ul: Diesel issue register by vehicle number.
Contractor invoices showing trips and diesel if supplied by you.

p: If you buy diesel and hand it to a contractor's tippers, check how your boundary treats it and apply the same rule every year.

senseible: Senseible reads bills, fuel invoices and production records into dated, fingerprinted records, so the figure you send a buyer can be traced to its documents.

sources.label: GHG Protocol Corporate Value Chain (Scope 3) Standard
